provider_name: GitHub REST API public repository releases (fixed repository allowlist)

access.authentication: none; official List releases docs allow unauthenticated requests for public resources
access.payment: no payment or credential sent; official docs describe public-data access; this is not a paid or trial route
access.documented_unauthenticated_limit: 60 requests per hour per originating IP; GitHub also applies secondary rate limits

smoke_evidence.qualification_limit: One anonymous first-page GET proves this exact public releases route responded; it does not qualify every GitHub endpoint, establish event time, or establish provider-wide availability.

access.policy: Anonymous GET only. Fixed repository and first page of at most 10 published releases. No retry, token, alternate host, asset download, or mutation operation.

routing.task: primary-source discovery for tagged ethereum/go-ethereum execution-client releases
routing.source_scope: A release is primary evidence that the ethereum/go-ethereum repository published a tagged Geth execution-client release and notes. It does not establish event time or cover all Ethereum ecosystem announcements.
routing.pagination: First page only; no pagination or automatic follow-up requests.
required_evidence: published_at and created_at preserved as publisher metadata
routing.timestamps: published_at and created_at remain provider release metadata; event_time_utc is explicitly null unless verified from the release content or another primary source.
routing.independence: GitHub-hosted publisher record; do not treat the API representation and GitHub Atom feed as independent sources.

request_policy.retry_policy: No automatic retries; stop and report auth, payment, forbidden, rate-limit, timeout, malformed response, or identity errors.
